where m.delete_flg = 'N' and m.publish_yn = 'Y'
and m.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and ( exists ( select 1 from bd_photo_board_file_dtl f where f.photo_seq = m.photo_seq and f.delete_flg = 'N' and f.content_type like 'image/%' ) or exists ( select 1 from bd_photo_board_file_dtl f where f.photo_seq = m.photo_seq and f.delete_flg = 'N' and f.content_type like 'video/%' ) )
and exists ( select 1 from bd_photo_board_file_dtl f where f.photo_seq = m.photo_seq and f.delete_flg = 'N' and f.content_type like 'image/%' )
and exists ( select 1 from bd_photo_board_file_dtl f where f.photo_seq = m.photo_seq and f.delete_flg = 'N' and f.content_type like 'video/%' )
mapper.select: select m.photo_seq as photoSeq, m.title, ( select count(*) from bd_photo_board_file_dtl f where f.photo_seq = m.photo_seq and f.delete_flg = 'N' ) as fileCount, m.publish_yn as publishYn, date(m.reg_dtm) as registeredDate, date(m.mod_dtm) as updatedDate from bd_photo_board_mst m where m.delete_flg = 'N' order by m.photo_seq desc

select photo_seq as photoSeq, title, publish_yn as publishYn, delete_flg as deleteFlg, reg_dtm as registeredAt, reg_id as registeredBy, mod_dtm as modifiedAt, mod_id as modifiedBy, view_cnt as viewCnt from bd_photo_board_mst where photo_seq = #{photoSeq} and delete_flg = 'N'

select photo_file_seq as photoFileSeq, photo_seq as photoSeq, original_file_name as originalFileName, stored_file_name as storedFileName, stored_path as storedPath, content_type as contentType, file_size as fileSize, sort_ord as sortOrder, delete_flg as deleteFlg, reg_dtm as registeredAt, reg_id as registeredBy, mod_dtm as modifiedAt, mod_id as modifiedBy, null as fileUrl from bd_photo_board_file_dtl where photo_seq = #{photoSeq} and delete_flg = 'N' order by sort_ord asc, photo_file_seq asc

select photo_file_seq as photoFileSeq, photo_seq as photoSeq, original_file_name as originalFileName, stored_file_name as storedFileName, stored_path as storedPath, content_type as contentType, file_size as fileSize, sort_ord as sortOrder, delete_flg as deleteFlg, reg_dtm as registeredAt, reg_id as registeredBy, mod_dtm as modifiedAt, mod_id as modifiedBy, null as fileUrl from bd_photo_board_file_dtl where photo_file_seq = #{photoFileSeq} and delete_flg = 'N'

select m.photo_seq as photoSeq, m.title, date(m.reg_dtm) as registeredDate, tf.photo_file_seq as thumbnailFileSeq, tf.content_type as thumbnailContentType, null as thumbnailFileUrl, exists ( select 1 from bd_photo_board_file_dtl f where f.photo_seq = m.photo_seq and f.delete_flg = 'N' and f.content_type like 'image/%' ) as hasImage, exists ( select 1 from bd_photo_board_file_dtl f where f.photo_seq = m.photo_seq and f.delete_flg = 'N' and f.content_type like 'video/%' ) as hasVideo from bd_photo_board_mst m left join bd_photo_board_file_dtl tf on tf.photo_file_seq = ( select f.photo_file_seq from bd_photo_board_file_dtl f where f.photo_seq = m.photo_seq and f.delete_flg = 'N' order by f.sort_ord asc, f.photo_file_seq asc limit 1 )
order by m.photo_seq desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select photo_seq as photoSeq, title, publish_yn as publishYn, delete_flg as deleteFlg, reg_dtm as registeredAt, reg_id as registeredBy, mod_dtm as modifiedAt, mod_id as modifiedBy, view_cnt as viewCnt from bd_photo_board_mst where photo_seq = #{photoSeq} and publish_yn = 'Y' and delete_flg = 'N'

select f.photo_file_seq as photoFileSeq, f.photo_seq as photoSeq, f.original_file_name as originalFileName, f.stored_file_name as storedFileName, f.stored_path as storedPath, f.content_type as contentType, f.file_size as fileSize, f.sort_ord as sortOrder, f.delete_flg as deleteFlg, f.reg_dtm as registeredAt, f.reg_id as registeredBy, f.mod_dtm as modifiedAt, f.mod_id as modifiedBy, null as fileUrl from bd_photo_board_file_dtl f inner join bd_photo_board_mst m on m.photo_seq = f.photo_seq and m.publish_yn = 'Y' and m.delete_flg = 'N' where f.photo_file_seq = #{photoFileSeq} and f.delete_flg = 'N'

insert into bd_photo_board_mst ( title, publish_yn, delete_flg, reg_dtm, reg_id, mod_dtm, mod_id ) values ( #{title}, #{publishYn}, 'N', current_timestamp, #{actorId}, current_timestamp, #{actorId} )
mapper.update: update bd_photo_board_mst set title = #{title}, publish_yn = #{publishYn}, mod_dtm = current_timestamp, mod_id = #{actorId} where photo_seq = #{photoSeq} and delete_flg = 'N'
mapper.insert:
select last_insert_id()
insert into bd_photo_board_file_dtl ( photo_seq, original_file_name, stored_file_name, stored_path, content_type, file_size, sort_ord, delete_flg, reg_dtm, reg_id, mod_dtm, mod_id ) values ( #{photoSeq}, #{originalFileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{storedPath}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{sortOrder}, 'N', current_timestamp, #{actorId}, current_timestamp, #{actorId} )
mapper.update: update bd_photo_board_mst set view_cnt = view_cnt + 1 where photo_seq = #{photoSeq} and delete_flg = 'N'
